statement: A plausible remaining explanation for the reported Steam gyro discrepancy is SDL/Steam motion-sensor-to-controller association or topology filtering for BUS_VIRTUAL/UHID, rather than the raw DualSense IMU report layout; a USB-gadget virtual topology succeeded when UHID did not.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, HHD adbd50f, virtualgamepad archive a5310c6; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: Inference from archived POC lines 46-58 plus consumer source, not an isolated causality test. Steam/SDL builds, backend, GUID and selected sensor nodes must be captured to confirm; other differences remain possible.
